decisions.executionNote: Approach the visible noodle cup with the right arm, keeping the gripper open and the left arm stationary; begin with small inward and downward increments.

Hold the measured pose to reconcile the previous accepted target with current wrist tracking before resuming a gentler angled approach.

Create additional clearance above and behind the cup rim before centering the gripper. The cup remains on the table, so no grasp is assumed.

The cup remains fixed between the pads in the wrist view during the test lift. Continue raising vertically by 6 cm with the gripper held closed and the other arm stationary.
